description: Defines log severity levels, related enums, functions, and operators for logging in the Abseil library.

classes.name: LogSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of log severity levels: INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL.

classes.name: LogSeverityAtLeast
classes.description: Enumeration for lower bounds of log severity levels.

classes.name: LogSeverityAtMost
classes.description: Enumeration for upper bounds of log severity levels.

methods.name: LogSeverities
methods.description: Returns an array of all standard log severity levels.

methods.name: LogSeverityName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a severity level.

methods.name: NormalizeLogSeverity
methods.description: Normalizes severity values outside the standard range to defined levels.
